root_causes.description: product-catalog shows a severe, isolated CPU surge (~2.1 cores) while every peer service stays near-idle (<0.13 cores). Requests that depend on it (frontend browse_product, recommendation get_recommendations, checkout add_to_cart) block for 15-30s, so client-facing calls exceed their deadline and surface as watchdog client errors while server-side error counters stay at zero.

evidence.expected_baseline: peer services in same window: checkout=0.031, cart=0.002, recommendation=0.012, frontend=0.120 cores
checkout add_to_cart p95 < 500ms in steady state
recommendation request p95 < 500ms in steady state

root_causes.description: Independent of the CPU reading, the dominant observable symptom is extreme request latency: checkout/frontend traces in the window show p95_duration=106509ms with individual spans pinned at 15000ms and 30000ms (deadline timeouts). All affected operations (browse_product, get_recommendations, add_to_cart) transitively depend on product-catalog, indicating product-catalog is the source of stalled responses.

evidence.observed_value: checkout server error rate = 0.000 across window, yet search_traces for checkout returned 20 traces / 0 with errors / p95_duration=106509ms (spans 15000ms, 30001ms, 30003ms)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout p95_duration < 500ms; no spans near the 15s/30s deadline

evidence.observed_value: user_get_recommendations=15000ms and user_browse_product=15001ms from frontend trace search (20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=106509ms)

root_causes.description: Kubernetes reports the quote container being killed and restarted alongside sandbox image pull failures/BackOff, which could add latency to the shipping→quote leaf path. Low confidence: only a single restart event and no corresponding error-rate or resource anomaly was observed for quote in this window.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container quote definition changed, will be restarted
evidence.observed_value: count=1 restart event for quote pod in otel-demo (with Failed/BackOff: ErrImagePull, ImagePullBackOff on pause image)

remediation_steps: Disable/roll back the cpu_stress (or equivalent latency) fault injection on the product-catalog service via its flagd flag and confirm product-catalog CPU returns to <0.2 cores.
Restart the product-catalog deployment pods to clear any stuck/contended state and re-check that browse_product, get_recommendations and add_to_cart p99 durations drop below 500ms.
Verify upstream impact clears: frontend and checkout client error rate returns to 0 and no spans are pinned at the 15s/30s deadline.
Inspect the quote pod restart / pause-image ImagePullBackOff events as a secondary item and re-create the quote pod if shipping latency remains elevated.
